Attached: 4 images

Turn your email backlog into 5 templates: sort the backlog by the reply it needs, write the quick yes and the polite no, the detail ask and the follow-up nudge, and the price and next step reply. File all five in one note and test each on a real reply. Templates are a start, not a send. Link in bio. #AIexplained #smallbusiness #productivity
